Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MAIDS Project Technical Support-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MAIDS Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support-II post?
faq.answer: A Three Years Graduate degree in science is required, along with two years of post-qualification work experience in research projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 26,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the MAIDS Project Technical Support-II post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the MAIDS office in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contract-based job as indicated by the 'Job Type' as 'Contract'.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
